loop_beats.description: More than 0. With it, the first loop_beats of the clip play again and again from its start until length_beats, each repetition a copy of the clip with its lead and fades; the last is cut off where the clip ends. daw clip loop CLIP BEATS|off sets it.
loop_beats.title: Loop Beats

length_beats.description: More than 0. How long a looped clip lasts on the timeline, from at; only with loop_beats. daw clip resize and daw audio trim --end set it.
length_beats.title: Length Beats

Group.description: A group: the tracks that name it summed through its own chain, gain and pan, then to the master and to the returns it sends to, as a drum bus.
Group.title: Group

Instrument.description: A sampler or the Synth: exactly one of the two.
Instrument.title: Instrument

Lane.description: Automation for one parameter. It overrides the static value for the whole song.
Lane.title: Lane

Lfo.description: A low-frequency oscillator of the Synth, bipolar, which moves what the matrix wires it to.

rate_hz.description: Cycles a second, unless rate_beats is given.
rate_hz.title: Rate Hz

rate_beats.description: One cycle in so many beats at the song's tempo, in place of rate_hz: more than 0 and at most 64.
rate_beats.title: Rate Beats

Lfo.title: Lfo

group.description: The group the track's output goes into instead of the master sum, one of groups[]; its tracks are next to each other.
group.title: Group

instrument.description: What the notes play; null plays nothing and keeps the notes.
instrument.title: Instrument

Modulation.description: An entry of the Synth's modulation matrix: a source moving a target by amount at full modulation, in the target's unit.
Modulation.title: Modulation

id.description: Unique in its clip. Left out, the next free nN is given when the song is validated.
id.title: Id

pitch.description: A MIDI number, 0 to 127, or a note name such as C4, which is 60 and is stored as its number.
pitch.title: Pitch

at.description: Beats from the clip's start. A note before it, at a negative at, or at or after its end is kept and does not play.
at.title: At

id.description: Unique among the song's note clips. Left out, the next free clipN is given when the song is validated.
id.title: Id

at.description: The song beat the clip starts on.
at.title: At

length_beats.description: More than 0. A note is cut off at the clip's end, and one that starts at or after it does not play.
length_beats.title: Length Beats

loop_beats.description: More than 0. With it, the notes of the clip's first loop_beats play again and again from its start until length_beats, the last repetition cut off there; a note held across the loop's end is cut there, and one that starts at or after it is kept and does not play. daw clip loop CLIP BEATS|off sets it.
loop_beats.title: Loop Beats

notes.description: A note, or [LOW, HIGH] for an inclusive range, as numbers or names. Entries may not overlap.
notes.title: Notes

pitched.description: Plays the pad at the note's pitch, repitched from its sample's root_note; otherwise the pad plays as it is.
pitched.title: Pitched

Oscillator.description: An oscillator of the Synth: one of up to four, each with its own wave, level, pan and tuning.

table.description: The wavetable a wavetable wave reads: organ, bright, hollow, vowel, fold or steps, or the ID of a sample in the project whose file is one cycle.
table.title: Table

pulse_width.description: The high part of a pulse's cycle, in percent.
pulse_width.title: Pulse Width

phase.description: Where in its cycle the wave starts, in percent; null starts each note at a random place from the seed.
phase.title: Phase

unison.description: How many copies of the wave play at once, spread in detune and across the stereo field.
unison.title: Unison

unison_detune_cents.description: How far the outermost copies are detuned either side of the pitch.
unison_detune_cents.title: Unison Detune Cents

unison_width_percent.description: How far the copies are spread across the stereo field from the pan.
unison_width_percent.title: Unison Width Percent

Oscillator.title: Oscillator

Point.description: An automation breakpoint. curve and shape are of the segment from here to the next point.
Point.title: Point

Return.description: A return bus: the sum of track sends through its own chain, then to master.
Return.title: Return

time_signature.description: Beats to a bar over the note that is one beat, 1 to 32 over 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16; one for the whole song. Positions stay quarter-note beats: a bar of 3/4 is 3 beats, of 6/8 3 and of 7/8 3.5.
time_signature.title: Time Signature

Synth.description: The Synth: a polyphonic synthesizer whose whole sound is this mapping.

patch.description: The name of the patch the sound came from; nothing reads it.
patch.title: Patch

width_percent.description: How far the voices are placed across the stereo field, either side of each oscillator's pan: 0 keeps every note where its oscillators are, 100 reaches the edges.
width_percent.title: Width Percent

width_mode.description: Where each note lands within the width: alternate puts each note on the other side from the last, pitch places low notes left and high notes right, random draws a place from seed.
width_mode.title: Width Mode

oscillators.description: One to four, by an ID the patch chooses, played in this order.
oscillators.title: Oscillators

envelopes.description: amp is always there and shapes the level; up to three more.
envelopes.title: Envelopes

macros.description: Up to eight knobs, 0 to 100, that do nothing but through the matrix.
macros.title: Macros

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: The patch's own effects, run on the sum of the voices before the track's inserts; a compressor here has no sidechain.

Synth.title: Synth

SynthEnvelope.description: An envelope of the Synth: amp shapes each voice's level, and any other moves what the matrix wires it to.
SynthEnvelope.title: SynthEnvelope

SynthFilter.description: The Synth's filter: one for each voice, after the oscillators that go through it.

resonance_percent.description: 0 is a Q of a half; 100 rings just short of self-oscillation.
resonance_percent.title: Resonance Percent

drive_db.description: Gain into a soft clip before the filter.
drive_db.title: Drive Db

keytrack_percent.description: How far the cutoff follows the note: 100 moves it an octave an octave from middle C.
keytrack_percent.title: Keytrack Percent

SynthFilter.title: SynthFilter

group.description: The group the track's output goes into instead of the master sum, one of groups[]; its tracks are next to each other.
group.title: Group

schema_version.description: Written by the tool: 2 for a song with a MIDI track, which an engine that knows only 1 refuses, otherwise 1. Either is read.
schema_version.title: Schema Version
